summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, disclosing a routine notification of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. The report details purchases of ordinary shares by CEO Tadeu Marroco and a closely associated person, totaling 10,000 shares at £43.06 each, for an aggregate value of £430,600. The transactions occurred on the London Stock Exchange and are standard insider trading disclosures under UK rules. No corporate event, board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved. This is purely a regulatory PDMR dealing notice, not a special situation. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; routine compliance filing.
